title: hieracium lanifolium subsp. colmeiroanum
intro: Hieracium lanifolium subsp. colmeiroanum, commonly known as Colmeiro's woolly hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Colmeiro's woolly hawkweed include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
